Summary of change: Multi-TRP enhancement Clause 7.3.1.2.1: Add a new field 'PRACH association indicator' in DCI format 1_0 to reflect agreements from RAN1#114bis and RAN1#115 meetings. [9] (ran1_cr_chunks 38.212, sim=0.644)
[CR CR0185 for 38.212] Reason for change: Capture the agreements and endorsed text proposals for Rel-18 MIMO evoluiation from RAN1#116 meeting. Summary of change: Multi-TRP enhancement Clause 7.3.1.2.1: Correct the field of ‘Reserved bits’ to reflect the impact of the field ‘PRACH association indicator’. Reference signal enhancement Clause 7.3.1.1.2 & 7.3.1.1.3 & 7.3.1.2.2: change the higher layer parameter enhanced-dmrs-Type to dmrs-TypeEnh, to align with 38.331. Enhanced uplink transmission Clause 7.3.1.1.2 & 7.3.1.1.3: correct the higher layer parameters to align with 38.331. CSI enhancement Clause 6.3.2.1.2: add the missing references to tables and sections. Consequences if not approved: The specification for Rel-18 MIMO Evolution for Downlink and Uplink is incomplete or incorrect.
